name: degrees-object-id-to-geojson
source: synthetic: built by hand from the field numbers in packs/sapient/pack.def (7 DetectionReport, 7.2 object_id, 7.6 Location: 1 x, 2 y, 3 z as doubles, 7 coordinate_system, 8 datum as varints); object_id is the example ULID of the ULID specification; doubles are little-endian IEEE-754 of the decimal text; x -85.95, y 30.009, z 12.5, coordinate_system 1 (degrees), datum 1 (WGS84 ellipsoid)
reference: 7.6.7 = 1 holds the when line of kind detection_report, the first kind that matches (engine-spec 0.5 Decode), so lon, lat, hae take x, y, z. convert derives uid from sapient.detection_report_object_id (model/sapient.def, engine-spec 0.6 Derived keys; uid is absent after decode). The geojson pack writes uid at id and lon, lat, hae at the coordinates; member order type, geometry, properties, id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); no properties key is present, so properties is {}.
